messages:
Maya Chen: Need to finalize webinar topic, abstract, and routing by EOD. Two quick asks: pick topic + confirm form fields.
Ravi Patel: I prefer 'Serving LLMs at Production Scale' 1. Short abstract incoming.
Alex Torres: I can demo but traveling Tue AM 1. Need backup for demo.
Jordan Lee: I'll moderate. Recommend 40min run: 5m intro, 12m Ravi, 12m Alex, 6m demo, 5m Qs.
Priya Singh: Form fields: email, company, role, deployment interest (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), ARR bucket, checkbox for benchmark report. Add GDPR opt-in for EU.
Sam O'Neill: I'll wire HubSpot. Routing: tag webinar=scaling_ops; ARR >=50k -> AE queue + Slack webhook to #webinar-leads. Low ARR -> SDR nurture.
Ravi Patel: Abstract draft:
"Serving LLMs at Production Scale \u2014 Practical patterns for routing, batching, caching, and fallbacks to reduce latency and cost. Includes a demo and benchmark report."
Alex Torres: Backup plan: pre-record full demo (fallback.mp4) + CLI snippet slide to show quick local curl if GPUs fail. I'll upload fallback by Mon EOD.
Jordan Lee: Moderator prep: 3 leading q's and a panic question to fill time if demo fails.
Maya Chen: Rehearsal windows: Tue 10:00 PT full run, Thu 09:00 PT tech-check. Confirm availability.
All: Confirmed.
Maya Chen: Action items: Ravi finalize abstract + upload fallback.mp4; Sam set HubSpot + webhook; Priya update registration copy; Jordan prepare cue sheet; Alex upload demo recording. Rehearsal Tue 10:00 PT.
